summary: Native Calc cell protection and unlocked selection are backed by actual model attributes, original selection semantics and protected output.
findings: Both menu commands, native history and tdf151752/tdf152327 pass through the actual Calc workspace.
Protected grid and input line visibility and clipboard formula-result conversion are verified and preserve original source cells.
The mounted test exposed a prior teardown ordering error. History now releases before the document style pool and the lifecycle checks pass.
residual_risks: Bitmap transfer, print projection and the full Format Cells dialog remain separate consumers. Existing size gate failures are outside changed files.
